item.title: ▫️ On Land, in Sky and at Sea: Indra 2026 Exercise starts The Indra 2026 joint Russian-Indian inter-service exercise
item.description: ▫️ On Land, in Sky and at Sea: Indra 2026 Exercise starts ➡️ The Indra 2026 joint Russian-Indian inter-service exercise has begun in Chelyabinsk region and the Russian Far East. The exercise involves ground force units from both countries, Russian Navy and Indian Navy warships as well as aircraft operated by the Russian Aerospace Forces. ▫️ The land phase of the exercise will run until 23 October at a Central MD training ground in Chelyabinsk region. Servicemen of the 90th Guards Tank Division (Central MD) and their Indian counterparts will practise command and control and neutralising illegal armed formations. ⚓️ The maritime phase will take place in the Sea of Japan on 16 and 17 October. Warships operating as part of a joint task force will practise tactical manoeuvring and conduct naval gunfire exercises. They will also carry out a boarding operation, liberate a vessel seized by a mock enemy, and repel attacks of unmanned aerial vehicles and uncrewed surface vessels. ✈️ Russian Aerospace Forces and Indian Air Force crews flying Su-30SM aircraft will conduct manoeuvring dog fights and practise engaging small low-altitude targets as well as aircraft carrying air-launched weapons. Mi-8 helicopter crews will deploy special forces and conduct search-and-rescue operations in hard-to-reach areas. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30042

▫️
On Land, in Sky and at Sea: Indra 2026 Exercise starts
➡️
The Indra 2026 joint Russian-Indian inter-service exercise
has begun in Chelyabinsk region and the Russian Far East. The exercise involves ground force units from both countries, Russian Navy and Indian Navy warships as well as aircraft operated by the Russian Aerospace Forces.
▫️
The land phase of the exercise will run until 23 October
at a Central MD training ground in Chelyabinsk region. Servicemen of the 90th Guards Tank Division (Central MD) and their Indian counterparts will
practise command and control and neutralising illegal armed formations.
⚓️
The maritime phase will take place in the Sea of Japan
on 16 and 17 October. Warships operating as part of a joint task force will practise tactical manoeuvring and conduct naval gunfire exercises. They will also carry out a boarding operation, liberate a vessel seized by a mock enemy, and repel attacks of unmanned aerial vehicles and uncrewed surface vessels.
✈️
Russian Aerospace Forces and Indian Air Force crews flying Su-30SM aircraft will conduct manoeuvring dog fights and practise engaging small low-altitude targets
as well as aircraft carrying air-launched weapons. Mi-8 helicopter crews will deploy special forces and conduct search-and-rescue operations in hard-to-reach areas.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 👉 Andrei Belousov inspects facilities of Russian Defence Ministry in Kyrgyzstan In the framework of his visit to Kyrgyzstan, Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov
item.description: Andrei Belousov inspects facilities of Russian Defence Ministry in Kyrgyzstan 👉 In the framework of his visit to Kyrgyzstan, Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov inspected facilities of the testing base located on Lake Issyk-Kul. ✅ The Minister checked the state of the base equipment , which includes boats and vessels of various projects prepared for testing. ➡️ The head of the testing base reported to the Russian Defence Minister that the main task of the base is to conduct serial tests of anti-submarine weapons of the Russian Navy as well as systems of defence against torpedoes mounted on surface ships and submarines. 🎮 Modern unmanned aerial vehicles enabled to carry out real-time control and surveillance tests. 📍 The base is a unique Russian military facility located at an altitude of 1,609 metres above mean sea level. Lake Issyk-Kul remains unfrozen all year round and its water is close to sea. It is ideal for testing sea weapons and diving gear. 💬 At the end of the inspection, the Russian Defence Minister held a meeting with the base command . He heard a report on current and future tasks, the progress of weapons testing, and development of infrastructure. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ➡️ Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov arrives on working visit to Cholpon-Ata in Kyrgyz Republic. There, meeting of Council of Ministers of Defence of the CIS will take place
item.description: Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov arrives on working visit to Cholpon-Ata in Kyrgyz Republic. There, meeting of Council of Ministers of Defence of the CIS will take place. ➡️ The event is to be visited by delegations from Azerbaijan, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Russia, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan as well as representatives of Council of Ministers of Defence of the CIS Secretariat. 📑 It is planned to discuss topical issues of the development of military cooperation in the CIS as well as to agree on joint activities of the CIS armed forces in 2027. 🤝 On the sidelines of the event, the Russian Defence Minister will have bilateral meetings with heads of delegations of defence ministries of the CIS member states. 📍 Moreover, Andrei Belousov will visit Russian military bases located in the Republic. The CIS Defence Ministers Council meets in follow-up to the agreements reached within the framework of the CIS Summit with the participation of President of the Russian Federation Vladimir Putin. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
